title: Ideal-power conductor multiplication
statement: For a finite intermediate B-subalgebra A of the fraction field K and z in (J(B)A)^r, every product z*a with a in A comes from B.

proof.text: Expand membership in the ideal power as finite sums of products of mapped Jacobson elements, apply the finite conductor theorem termwise, and sum the resulting base elements.

lean.statement:
theorem Subalgebra.exists_base_mul_mem_of_mem_map_jacobson_pow
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    [Finite (MaximalSpectrum B)] (hdim : ringKrullDim B = 1)
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K]
    (A : Subalgebra B K) [Module.Finite B A] [IsFractionRing A K]
    {r : ℕ} (z : A)
    (hz : z ∈ (Ideal.map (algebraMap B A) (Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal B))) ^ r)
    (a : A) : ∃ c : B, algebraMap B K c = (z : K) * (a : K)
